svg.text: S1 GRAB FROM TOP — worst case: digging out the bottom box
The trolley lifts the 13 boxes above the target one by one onto neighbour stacks, then takes the target to the port.
worst case: bottom box of a full stack, 13 boxes above it
14 moves ≈ 72 s (hoist 1.5 m/s) · ≈ 106 s with a 0.8 m/s hoist
box on top 3.7 s · mean with pre-digging ≈ 6 s
target ≤ 30 s (STO-003) holds only for the top 6 boxes of a stack
TOP VIEW — real trolley path (0.55 px/mm)
Time against depth (boxes above the target, full stack):
THE SIX STACKS INVOLVED, side by side (true heights, 0.32 px/mm; spacing schematic)
K9b transport gallery (not part of S1)

g.text: 0/14 Target T = the bottom box of the full stack A-R (14 high): 13 boxes lie on top of it.
1/14 Dig: box 1 is lifted only until it clears the post tops, then set on the neighbour stack A-M.
2/14 Box 2 from A-R onto A-M. The dug boxes stay where they are put.
3/14 Box 3 from A-R onto B-R. The dug boxes stay where they are put.
4/14 Box 4 from A-R onto A-M. The dug boxes stay where they are put.
5/14 Box 5 from A-R onto B-R. The dug boxes stay where they are put.
6/14 Box 6 from A-R onto A-M. The dug boxes stay where they are put.
7/14 Box 7 from A-R onto B-R. The dug boxes stay where they are put.
8/14 Box 8 from A-R onto A-M (now full, 14). The dug boxes stay where they are put.
9/14 Box 9 from A-R onto B-R (now full, 14). The dug boxes stay where they are put.
10/14 A-M and B-R are full: box 10 goes to the diagonal neighbour B-M.
11/14 Box 11 from A-R onto C-R. The dug boxes stay where they are put.
12/14 Box 12 from A-R onto B-M. The dug boxes stay where they are put.
13/14 Last box above T goes to C-R. T is now on top of its stack, at the bottom of the column.
14/14 T: plate down 1.58 m, grip, up 1.69 m to the dock; the load cell weighs it and the RFID tag is read.
14/14 Over to the port stack B-F under the roof hatch, set T down, hooks open, plate back up.
Done: T sits on the port and the K9b gallery lifts it out through the roof hatch. Real time ≈ 72 s.
